method: Second visual tracing on unmodified v7 ground-only coordinate grids. No import of mask-annotations, repair polygons or production mask pixels. Same AI reviewer; not independent human QA. Polygons classify conservative definite-liquid interiors; everything else is unknown, never presumed solid.
referencePolicy: freeze reference before measuring; polygons must not be fitted to production mask. Unknown pixels count against the conservative leakage upper bound. Interior exclusions (unlabelledPolygons) stay unknown. Their semantic solid/liquid class is not asserted by the measurement.

icefall-east-cliff.reviewNote: Curtain and water-side base only, traced from the unmodified 4x ground detail. Dark faceted cliff behind dispersed spray remains unknown. Repair uses a separate hard-surface contour.

icefall-upper-tree.reviewNote: Ground-only enlarged upper curtain inspected. Union of two separately traced portions covers the visible cyan falling water behind the branch. Tree, snow and lower faceted spires excluded. No production mask geometry imported.

icefall-summit.limitation: Central main curtains and lower cascade only. The upper narrow blue spires remain semantically uncertain after magnified ground review; side cascades and edge pixels also remain unknown.

lavafall-volcano.reviewNote: Main yellow/orange curtain, receiving toe and separate narrow right ribbon. Dark centre-right cliff remains unlabelled.

lavafall-upper-left.reviewNote: Vertical curtain and bright receiving surface; foreground dark rim excluded.

lavafall-upper-step.reviewNote: Lava curtain with left cliff and lower-right pointed rock excluded by visible silhouettes.

lavafall-west.reviewNote: Continuous falls above the orange receiving basin. Lower rock peaks excluded.

lavafall-bridge.reviewNote: Orange/red vertical sheets. Small dark floating/foreground rocks remain excluded; bright lava streaks continue behind them. Ground texture recheck excludes the upper-left dark cracked cliff, including its glowing seams.

lavafall-middle.reviewNote: Curtain on both sides of the large lower central rock. Rock and foreground peak excluded.

lavafall-lower-step.reviewNote: Wide molten curtain with lower left and right rock lips omitted. Dark-red folds within the curtain are retained as drawn lava.

lavafall-mouth.reviewNote: Split lava curtains and receiving pool. Dark right cliff and bottom lip remain unknown.

icefall-mouth.reviewNote: Drawn descending water beneath bridge, lower cascade and receiving stream. Bridge, plants and the two dark rocks excluded.
